783-2645-2930-3430.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
783-2645-2930-3430.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1003-1329-2178-3899.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-3899.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7157-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4613-7816.description:
Activate Titanbones by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Titanbones triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5705-5957.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-3259-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-4875-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4875-6797.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3169-6972-7137.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Cytoplast Manipulator.
3169-6972-7137.description:
Kill Cytoplast Manipulator.
When Cytoplast Manipulator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its graft ability.
When Cytoplast Manipulator enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Cytoplast Manipulator triggers, moving a +1/+1 counter from it to the creature token. Cytoplast Manipulator dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

343-2366-4885-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-2366-4885-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

101-109-232-1235.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Vampire Charmseeker.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Vampire Charmseeker with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Vampire Charmseeker tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

877-4254-5125.description:
Cast Sparkcaster by paying {0}.
When Sparkcaster enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1350-1879-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-1879-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

2105-6426.easyPrerequisites: Sandstorm Crasher does not have summoning sickness.
2105-6426.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2105-6426.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and Sandstorm Crasher as attackers, choosing to exert Sandstorm Crasher and Combat Celebrant as they attack. Combat Celebrant and Sandstorm Crasher each trigger.
Resolve the Sandstorm Crasher trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

603-2034-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
603-2034-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

803-2921-5853.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
803-2921-5853.description:
Cast Wick by paying {3}{B}.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1203-4567.notablePrerequisites:
Greven does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Greven is your commander.
Your life total is at least 17.
There is at least one additional creature on the battlefield.
1203-4567.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by paying {1}{B}{R} and 16 life, dealing 16 damage divided among any number of creatures and causing Greven to become a 21/21 until end of turn due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven.
The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 combat damage from your commander.

1114-1414-1887.description:
Cast Wrenn and Realmbreaker by paying {1}{G}{G}, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Wrenn and Realmbreaker's third loyalty ability by removing seven loyalty counters from it, causing you to get an emblem.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 3.

357-1528-2178-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature.
The creature with Dual Casting attached does not have summoning sickness.
357-1528-2178-5231.description:
Cast Force of Rage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Force of Rage.
Resolve the copy of Force of Rage, creating two  3/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing an Elemental, adding {R}.
The Elemental dies, triggering the creature with Thornbite Staff attached, untapping the creature.
Repeat from step 2 for an arbitrarily large number of creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Elementals, adding {2}.
Thornbite Staff triggers twice, untapping the equipped creature.
Activate the equipped creature by paying {2} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 7.

1843-2011-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Tervigon and Najeela do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Tervigon.
Tervigon has a power of at least six.
1843-2011-4050.description:
Deal combat damage to a player with Tervigon.
Tervigon triggers, creating at least six 1/1 Tyranid Warrior tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing five Tyranid Warrior tokens, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
